o.norm: java.lang.ClassCastException: Cannot cast java.lang.String to org.apache.commons.cli.Option

i.norm:
Verifies that {@link CommandLine#getParsedOptionValues(Option, Supplier)} throws a {@link ParseException} when the parsed value cannot be converted to the option's declared type.

The option declares its type as {@code Option.class}, but its only value is the plain string {@code "D"}. Converting that string and casting it to {@code Option} raises a {@link ClassCastException} internally, which the method wraps and rethrows as a {@link ParseException}.
An option named "D" that accepts an argument and declares its type as Option.class.
Register the option on the command line and give it the string value "D".
The default-value supplier is never consulted here because the option does have a value; a strict mock makes that explicit (any use would fail the test).
The underlying ClassCastException ("Cannot cast java.lang.String to org.apache.commons.cli.Option") is wrapped in a ParseException.
